tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The stage behind cards: app background, page gutters, the grey field every card floats on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the booking search, the ticket panel. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset plates inside a card (ticket details, field tiles), segmented-control tracks, chip rest state.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts and dialogs that sit above cards. Always paired with shadow-float.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card outlines on canvas, separators inside inset plates.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Text-field and tile borders at rest. Fields are identified by their always-visible label plus this border; hover and focus states raise contrast.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Small control outlines that must be found without a label (unchecked checkbox, stepper buttons). 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-sunken and canvas.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface, surface-sunken and canvas: descriptions, city names, field labels.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text on surface and canvas: timestamps, weekday labels, placeholder text. 4.5:1 minimum on both grounds.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text that sits on an ink-coloured fill (active nav pill, tooltips).

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Selected-range band in the calendar, brand-soft badge ground, hover wash on brand-adjacent rows.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Focus halo around fields, soft brand pill ground.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Light chart series, hatch stripes on brand-tinted bars.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Secondary chart series, decorative brand blocks.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Brand hover state, gauge segments.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Ion Blue, the brand. Brand buttons, selected dates, active switches, the focus ring. Text on it uses on-brand.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links on surface and canvas (7:1).

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Pressed brand buttons; text on blue-50 and blue-100.

tokens.name: blue-900
tokens.usage: Deep navy accent blocks and chart emphasis.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-500 fills.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Airy tint for marketing bands and empty states. Never behind body text smaller than 15px.

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Secondary airy tint, illustrated sky fields, cover blocks.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Ground of the onboarding screens and illustration tiles. Matches the background baked into the onboarding art, so images blend with no edge.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: The night-flight panel: login hero, promo cards, the dark side of split layouts. Text on it is white.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary call to action fill (Book now, Check availability, Log in).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on action fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed bookings, positive deltas. Text on surface and success-tint. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and toasts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending payment, few seats left. Text on surface and warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and toasts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancelled, failed payment, field errors. Text on surface and danger-tint. Always paired with a word or alert icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and error toasts.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars only. Never text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted caption plates and icon buttons laid over photography. Always with backdrop blur 16px.

tokens.name: glass-dark
tokens.usage: Smoked chips and price tags over photography where white text sits on the image.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: The 1px top-lit edge of glass plates.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet backdrop.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero only, one per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing section heads, login hero line.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Airport codes on tickets, page titles in the app.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Headline numbers on stat cards. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Prices on booking bars and stay cards.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen title, one per view.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card titles on listing detail, section heads inside a screen.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card headers on dashboards, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Escape to nature in this cozy cabin, surrounded by forest and lakes.
styles.usage: Listing descriptions, marketing paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in.
styles.usage: Default UI text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in cards, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field values, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels inside tiles, chart axes, badge text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows and nav group labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Booking references, flight numbers, seat codes, card last-4.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Ticket meta, table cells with codes.

styles.name: m-large-title
styles.usage: Large title at the top of a tab's root screen. Collapses to m-headline when scrolled.

styles.name: m-title
styles.usage: Greetings and hero titles.

styles.name: m-title-2
styles.usage: Section headers on mobile screens.

styles.name: m-headline
styles.usage: App bar titles, primary buttons, list row titles.

styles.name: m-body
styles.sample: Escape to nature in this cozy cabin.
styles.usage: Body copy and every text input (16px or more stops iOS zooming into fields).

styles.name: m-subhead
styles.usage: Chips, segmented controls, secondary row text.

styles.name: m-footnote
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles.

styles.name: m-caption
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels inside tiles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills in a group, icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and inset tiles; gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap in card content; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inset plate padding (ticket details).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on dashboards; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on hero cards and sheets; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on marketing pages (tablet).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on marketing pages (desktop).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags inside dense tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, calendar day cells, inset tiles inside plates.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset plates nested in a card (radius-lg minus its padding).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard cards, dashboard tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards: stay cards, ticket, booking search, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The app frame on desktop and device-style containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, segmented controls, nav bars, avatars.

shadow.note: Shadows are soft and long with a tight contact edge. Cards on canvas use shadow-card; anything that floats above cards uses shadow-float.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Pills and icon buttons resting on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Stay cards, the ticket, toasts, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass plates and glass icon buttons over photography.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: The one brand-coloured glow: the search disc and brand primary buttons on hover.

duration.note: How long things take. Shorter for small objects and direct feedback, longer for big surfaces and celebrations.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, focus ring, colour on tap.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and background changes, tooltips appearing.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sliding indicators (tabs, segmented, nav), chip and switch state, popovers.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Card lift, toasts, dialogs, panel content changes.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, onboarding slides, mobile push and pop. Use with ease-sheet.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Route and page transitions on the web.

tokens.name: duration-emphasis
tokens.usage: Chart lines drawing, bars growing, numbers counting up.

tokens.name: duration-celebrate
tokens.usage: The big stop: booking confirmed, payment done. Once per flow.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings entering in a list, grid or chart (cap the cascade at 12 items).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky booking bar and top nav.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Date picker, menus.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

touch.note: Mobile layout and touch values. Everything a finger presses is at least tap-min.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target in any direction (icon buttons, chips, checkboxes with their label).

tokens.name: tap-comfort
tokens.usage: Primary controls: search field, field tiles, sticky CTA, FAB.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Left and right screen padding on phones.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: Space reserved at the top for the status bar (use env(safe-area-inset-top) in the app).

tokens.name: home-indicator
tokens.usage: Space reserved under the last control (use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) in the app).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Docked tab bar including the home indicator area.

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: Compact app bar.

tokens.name: sheet-radius
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: card-radius-mobile
tokens.usage: Hero cards, place cards and agenda cards on phones.

easing.note: Motion curves. Enter decelerates, exit accelerates, spring overshoots slightly for things that pop into place.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for state changes that stay on screen: hover, sliding indicators, resizing.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: pages, cards, toasts, popovers, chart draws.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: dialogs, sheets and toasts closing. Exits run at about 70% of the enter duration.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small objects popping into place: switch knob, heart, selected day, tab icon, arrow disc.

tokens.name: ease-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, mobile push and pop, onboarding slides.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Only for loops: shimmer, spinners, dash flow, progress timers.
